data.one_liner: Extracts metadata such as OpenGraph, Twitter Cards, and JSON-LD from web pages.
data.what_it_does: A Dart library that fetches and parses web pages to extract metadata like title, description, image, and URL. It supports OpenGraph, Meta tags, Twitter Cards, and Structured Data (Json-LD).
use_when: You need to fetch and display link previews from URLs.
You want to extract SEO metadata like OpenGraph or Twitter Cards from web pages.
avoid_when: You need a full web scraping engine with JavaScript rendering capabilities.
strengths: Supports multiple metadata formats including OpenGraph, Twitter Cards, and Json-LD.
Provides both high-level fetching and low-level manual parsing options.
weaknesses: Does not support JavaScript rendering, so it may miss metadata generated dynamically by client-side scripts.
